subtitle: AI protein tracker & meal scan
promotionalText: AI meal scanning, daily protein goals, and a dragon that evolves when you hit your target.
description:
ProteinQuest turns hitting your protein goal into a daily game you actually want to play.

Snap any meal with your camera. AI estimates the protein in seconds — no manual logging, no barcode hunting, no guesswork. Set your personalized daily target once, then build the habit one scan at a time.

HOW IT WORKS
• Scan meals with your camera or photo library
• Get instant AI protein estimates for each dish
• Track your progress toward one clear daily goal
• Review your food log and trends over time

YOUR DAILY DRAGON
Every morning, pick Ember, Frost, or Moss — your dragon for the day. Hit your protein goal to earn XP and evolve through five forms. Streaks, levels, and unlocks keep you coming back without feeling like a chore.

PROTEINQUEST PRO
Free includes 3 AI scans per day. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited scans and full trends history.

Weekly: £6.99/week
Yearly: £29.99/year (best value)

Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://proteinquest.vercel.app/privacy

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Whether you're bulking, cutting, or just trying to eat enough protein, ProteinQuest focuses on the one number that matters most.

ProteinQuest provides nutritional estimates for informational purposes only. It is not medical advice.

appStoreConnectChecklist: Enroll in Apple Developer Program first ($99/yr, can take 24-48h) — critical path
Run `eas init` then `eas build --platform ios --profile production` (EAS registers the bundle ID and manages certs)
Create app in App Store Connect: name ProteinQuest, bundle ID com.proteinquest.app, SKU proteinquest-ios-001
Copy the numeric Apple App ID into eas.json submit.production.ios.ascAppId (plus appleId and appleTeamId)
Create subscription group 'ProteinQuest Pro' with pro_weekly (£6.99/wk) and pro_yearly (£29.99/yr)
In RevenueCat: add iOS app for com.proteinquest.app, upload In-App Purchase key, copy the appl_ public SDK key into EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY (must be set at build time)
Upload screenshots from store/screenshots/iphone67, store/screenshots/ipad13, and store/screenshots/mac
Fill App Information, pricing (Free), and paste listing fields from this file
Complete App Privacy questionnaire using the appPrivacy section above
Complete age rating questionnaire using ageRatingAnswers above (expect 4+)
Run `eas submit --platform ios --profile production` to upload the build
Test the purchase flow in TestFlight (sandbox), then submit for review with the reviewNotes above
